title: feat(nm2chiralz): oriented 1-in 2-out frame at t+1 on two-axis opposite z-probes: reverse fails, face HOLD
science: Two-axis opposite seed, z-probes, oriented 1-in 2-out frame: Orient(q) = sign det(m, o1, o2) with (o1,o2) the two Axis(O) unit vectors in canonical order e1<e2<e3. Because cover forces Axis(O) to be the complement of Axis(M), the outgoing plane is determined by m, and I verified Orient(q) = sgn(m)*eps(axis(m)) with eps(e1)=eps(e3)=+1, eps(e2)=-1 for all six letters - the determinant carries zero information about O. The band's only handedness probe produces no handedness.
